description: Trainee will learn about the emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, crafting effective prompts using Open AI / GPT. They will perform Image Generation, Text Generation, Music Generation, Video Generation and working with Style Transfer Models, Language Models, Audio Synthesis Models, Animation Models. They will also perform Branding and e-commerce with AI tools and interpret the ethical challenges of generative AI and Responsible AI.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Introduction to AI and Crafting effective prompts using OpenAI / GPT.
Perform Text Generation and working with Language Models.
Perform Image Generation and working with Style Transfer Models.
Perform Music Generation and working with Audio Synthesis Models.
Perform Video Generation and working with Animation Models.
Perform Branding and e-commerce with AI Tools and interpret the ethical challenges of generative AI and Responsible AI.
